title: iewa-world-heavyweight
label: Fast Eddie

won.source: Held as of the fed's own founding advertisement, 2 January 1997; no won-date survives in the held record.

note: The fed's own first World Heavyweight Champion, per its founding advertisement; the held record does not show how or when the reign ended before the Vulture's own hold on the title (evidenced from September 1997).

title: iewa-north-american
label: Fast Eddie
note: Won alongside the World Heavyweight Title and vacated under the fed's own one-title rule; the North American Title is listed vacant in the same founding advertisement and no successor survives in the held record.

title: iewa-world-tag-team
label: Skull & Dave Douglas
note: The fed's own first World Tag Team Champions, per its founding advertisement; the held record does not trace the lineage forward to Damage's own hold on the titles (evidenced from September 1997).

title: iewa-world-television
label: Dave Scar
note: The fed's own first Television Champion, per its founding advertisement; the held record does not trace the lineage forward to the Vulture's own hold on the title (evidenced from September 1997).

title: iewa-world-heavyweight
label: The Vulture

won.source: Held as of the Bloodbath card's own commentary ("undefeated since March"); no won-date survives in the held record.

note: Loses the title to Leeb on 22 September 1997 in sixteen seconds, following an Armageddon ambush before the bell.

title: iewa-world-heavyweight
label: Leeb
note: Defeats the Vulture in sixteen seconds for the title after an Armageddon pre-match ambush; the prior reign (the Vulture's) is recorded from the same card as the losing side.

title: iewa-hardcore
label: "Kryokiller" Ken Wilson

won.source: Held entering the 22 September 1997 Iron Man defense; no won-date survives in the held record.

note: Retains the title over Thunder Rider in a 60-minute Iron Man match, 9 falls to 8, on 22 September 1997.

title: iewa-world-tag-team
label: Damage (Kain & Die Maschine)

won.source: Held entering the 22 September 1997 card per the fed's own same-day recruitment post; no won-date survives in the held record.

note: Lose the title to the Horsemen on 22 September 1997.

title: iewa-world-tag-team
label: The Horsemen (Rig & Lord Nightmare)
note: Defeat Damage (Kain & Die Maschine) for the title on 22 September 1997.
